verdict.rationale: LightSprint is an AI coding platform that handles user code and data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for it. The evidence never states a no-training policy or a training opt-out control. Related features (bring-your-own API keys, routing model traffic through an approved gateway, and self-hosting) are adjacent infrastructure controls. None of them documents that customer data is excluded from AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
